description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquire the lands in Negombo D/S Division's & Meerigama, District of Gampaha for Water Supply Projects
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains multiple orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific immovable properties (land parcels) for water treatment plants and infrastructure projects. The content includes detailed descriptions of land boundaries, locations, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While a minister is named and his portfolio is mentioned, this is incidental to the core land acquisition purpose rather than being about government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
